use: resonance line for collinear and in-source laser spectroscopy of Bi isotopes (hyperfine structure, nuclear moments, charge radii; COLLAPS/ISOLDE with a frequency-doubled dye laser at 307 nm, IRIS Gatchina)

magnetic-dipole line used for parity-nonconservation optical-rotation measurements in Bi vapour: R = Im(E1/M1) = -7.8(1.8)e-8 on the F=6 -> F'=7 component (Birich et al., Zh. Eksp. Teor. Fiz. 87, 776 (1984) [Sov. Phys. JETP 60, 442], http://jetp.ras.ru/cgi-bin/dn/e_060_03_0442.pdf)

magnetic-dipole line of the Oxford parity-nonconservation optical-rotation experiment: R = Im(E1_PNC/M1) = -10.12(20)e-8 (Macpherson, Zetie, Warrington, Stacey, Hoare, Phys. Rev. Lett. 67, 2784 (1991), https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.67.2784)
